svg.title: Install once. Each agent sees only its own skills.
svg.desc: One shared install of 200 skills and 11 MCP servers feeds nine agents. Skills each agent can see: build / plan (40), design (48), career (49), ai-research (123), security (32), reverse-engineering (31), 3d-modeling (27), second-opinion (19), local-model (21). Installs into OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and about 40 more tools with rulesync.

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Per-agent filtering is enforced where the tool supports it: skills, MCP servers and subagents in OpenCode, MCP servers in Claude Code.

text.font-family: 'Geist', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Other tools get each agent's instructions; install specialist skills there with a folder group.

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Counts cover the default group. Installed separately as native plugins: Trail of Bits (95 skills, security agent), IoTHackBot (13 skills, reverse-engineering agent).
